cms_public_notices.observation: Live official listing checked before the 12 additional searches. The seven October 30 termination notices (CCNs B31564, A11721, 234047, 368355, 368395, 369294, 369309) remain newest and had been recorded in earlier watch runs. No newly listed rescission, termination, or CLIA limitation/suspension identified. A Medicare termination notice does not itself establish physical closure.

coverage_notes.limitations: All searches completed, but recent local, rural, tribal and U.S. territorial indexing is incomplete; search results predominantly covered older announcements and previous disruptions. Absence of a qualifying finding is not proof of exhaustive coverage. No conclusion about primary collector completeness.
coverage_notes.controls: Exactly one heartbeat-only JSON created on ops/watch-ledger; no review approval, public publication, production collector mutation, schedule change or task disabling.
